claims.exact_allowed_wording_en: Within the declared graph adapters and frozen policies, FlipGuard directly synthesized CKKS literals from computation graphs and threshold decision-integrity contracts.
claims.exact_allowed_wording_ko: FlipGuard는 선언된 graph adapter와 동결 정책 범위에서 computation graph와 threshold decision-integrity contract로부터 CKKS literal을 직접 합성했다.
claims.reviewer_rationale: All declared primary instances produced admitted literals under the frozen policy; breadth beyond the adapters was not evaluated.
claims.scope: declared tabular, polynomial, Sobel, Harris, and scalar-replicated CNN-lite adapters
claims.statistical_unit: workload-partition instance, with seed roles reported separately
claims.title: Scoped direct CKKS configuration synthesis

claims.exact_allowed_wording_en: In the declared development ablation, FlipGuard's frozen bounded repair converted four one-shot failures into SAFE selections; this does not imply universal repair success.
claims.exact_allowed_wording_ko: FlipGuard의 동결된 bounded repair는 선언된 개발 ablation에서 one-shot 실패 네 건을 SAFE 선택으로 전환했으며, 이는 보편적 repair 성공을 뜻하지 않는다.
claims.reviewer_rationale: The one-shot/full contrast isolates empirical repair value while retaining failures and bounded termination.
claims.scope: predeclared development ablation and observed repair causes
claims.title: Bounded failure-aware repair

claims.exact_allowed_wording_en: FlipGuard used 70 encrypted candidate trials versus 700 Security-V2 bounded-catalog candidates overall and 56 versus 560 in the confirmatory partitions, a 90% reduction in both cases.
claims.exact_allowed_wording_ko: FlipGuard는 Security-V2 bounded catalog의 700개 후보 대비 전체 70회, confirmatory 560개 후보 대비 56회의 encrypted candidate trial을 사용해 두 경우 모두 90% 감소를 기록했다.
limitations: 1,100 executions are historical pre-security accounting only
claims.reviewer_rationale: The denominator excludes 400 Security-V2-inadmissible candidates and separates seed 0 from seeds 1-4.
claims.scope: Security-V2-admitted 7 profiles x 2 paths over the declared instances
claims.title: Formal Security-V2 trial reduction

claims.exact_allowed_wording_en: Byte-identical frozen literals passed no-retuning locked audit in 40/40 confirmatory seed-1-4 instances and 10/10 development seed-0 instances.
claims.exact_allowed_wording_ko: 동결 literal의 no-retuning locked audit은 confirmatory seeds 1-4에서 40/40, development seed 0에서 10/10 통과했다.
claims.reviewer_rationale: The audit replays the selected literal without synthesis or repair and preserves the seed-role distinction.
claims.scope: 10 dataset-model workloads and five deterministic repeated partitions
claims.statistical_unit: 10 dataset-model workloads with repeated partitions; seed 0 is descriptive
claims.title: Primary no-retuning locked audit

claims.exact_allowed_wording_en: The predeclared budget control returned NO_SAFE in 16/40 instances, and the declared finite-domain control returned NO_SAFE in 50/50 instances.
claims.exact_allowed_wording_ko: 사전동결 budget control은 40건 중 16건에서 NO_SAFE를, 선언된 finite-domain control은 50/50에서 NO_SAFE를 반환했다.
claims.reviewer_rationale: The controls demonstrate fail-closed abstention only within their predeclared candidate budgets.
claims.scope: one-candidate budget control and declared two-candidate finite domain
claims.title: Scoped NO_SAFE abstention

claims.exact_allowed_wording_en: Across the declared post-freeze workload partitions, FlipGuard's directly synthesized configurations reduced paired total inference latency relative to the Security-V2-compliant bounded-catalog fastest-safe configurations; the exact clustered geometric-mean ratio and confidence interval are reported.
claims.exact_allowed_wording_ko: 선언된 post-freeze workload partition에서 direct configuration은 Security-V2 bounded-catalog fastest-safe configuration보다 paired total inference latency를 줄였으며, 정확한 clustered geometric-mean ratio와 confidence interval을 함께 보고한다.
claims.reviewer_rationale: All 40 confirmatory instances are complete and the cluster-bootstrap lower bound exceeds one, but hardware and workload generality are limited.
claims.scope: one host, frozen direct and Security-V2 bounded-catalog arms
claims.statistical_unit: 10 dataset-model clusters; seeds 1-4 repeat within cluster
claims.title: Confirmatory paired latency

claims.exact_allowed_wording_en: For mlp_square_poly3, 25/25 instances were selected and no-retuning audit produced 24 PASS results and one reserve-policy REJECT without a decision flip.
claims.exact_allowed_wording_ko: mlp_square_poly3는 25/25 선택됐고 no-retuning audit에서 24건 PASS와 decision flip 없는 reserve-policy REJECT 1건을 기록했다.
prohibited_overclaim: unseen audits always preserve the reserve policy
claims.reviewer_rationale: The valid negative result lowers the claim and demonstrates that selection success is not audit success.
claims.scope: five datasets x five deterministic partitions for mlp_square_poly3
claims.title: Deeper polynomial structural extension

claims.exact_allowed_wording_en: The Sobel, Harris, and CNN-lite adapters provide selection and no-retuning audit evidence only for their declared finite inputs and scalar-replicated execution scopes.
claims.exact_allowed_wording_ko: Sobel, Harris, CNN-lite adapter는 각 선언된 finite input과 scalar-replicated execution 범위에서 selection과 no-retuning audit evidence를 제공한다.
claims.reviewer_rationale: Multiple non-tabular adapters broaden finite scope but do not establish arbitrary packed graph support.
claims.scope: BSDS500 Sobel/Harris patches and MNIST CNN-lite scalar-replicated adapter
claims.statistical_unit: declared image cluster or image input, as specified by each pack
claims.title: Scoped non-tabular adapters

claims.exact_allowed_wording_en: Nine model instances from three datasets and three independent training/data seeds achieved 9/9 selection and no-retuning audit PASS.
claims.exact_allowed_wording_ko: 세 dataset과 세 independent training/data seed로 생성한 9개 model instance가 9/9 selection과 no-retuning audit PASS를 기록했다.
claims.reviewer_rationale: The extension addresses fixed-model reuse but remains too small for universal training generalization.
claims.scope: 3 datasets x 3 predeclared independent training/data seeds
claims.statistical_unit: trained model instance, grouped by dataset
claims.title: Independent training/data-seed extension

claims.exact_allowed_wording_en: Selected exact Q/P literals were re-attested under Security Policy V2 and two estimator models; exact equivalence to Lattigo's truncated Xe distribution is not claimed.
claims.exact_allowed_wording_ko: 선택 후보의 exact Q/P를 Security Policy V2와 두 estimator model에서 재감사했으며, 실제 Lattigo Xe truncation과 estimator 분포의 exact equivalence는 주장하지 않는다.
claims.reviewer_rationale: Q and QP are checked separately and estimator sensitivity is complete for the declared objects, with an explicit distribution caveat.
claims.scope: attested direct, catalog, reference, and latency-arm literals
claims.statistical_unit: distinct cryptographic object and estimator model
claims.title: Security-V2 and exact-Q/P attestation

claims.exact_allowed_wording_en: FlipGuard combines observed error and decision margin to certify or reject candidates on declared finite validation artifacts and replays the frozen literal on disjoint audits.
claims.exact_allowed_wording_ko: FlipGuard는 선언된 finite validation에서 관측 error와 decision margin을 결합해 후보를 certify-or-reject하고, disjoint audit에서 동결 literal을 재생한다.
claims.reviewer_rationale: The evidence supports the gate behavior and observed finite-set outcomes, not a domain-wide approximation theorem.
claims.scope: declared finite validation and locked-audit artifacts
claims.statistical_unit: certifiable sample-key observation within each declared artifact
claims.title: Finite-scope decision-integrity admission

limitations: The primary natural range showed zero literal changes because the minimum synthesis floor dominated.
prohibited_overclaim: Natural-data decision margin changes the synthesized literal
claims.reviewer_rationale: The primary natural range showed zero literal changes because the minimum synthesis floor dominated.
claims.scope: not admitted
claims.title: Natural-data decision margin changes the synthesized literal

limitations: Primitive CKKS residual bounds are not instantiated.
claims.reviewer_rationale: Primitive CKKS residual bounds are not instantiated.
claims.scope: not admitted
claims.title: Instantiated analytical CKKS certificate

claims.reviewer_rationale: Finite observed artifacts do not establish distribution-wide safety.
claims.scope: not admitted
claims.title: Distribution-wide decision safety

claims.reviewer_rationale: Only declared adapters were evaluated.
claims.scope: not admitted
claims.title: Arbitrary graph support

claims.reviewer_rationale: The comparator is a finite Security-V2 bounded catalog.
claims.scope: not admitted
claims.title: Global optimality

claims.reviewer_rationale: Matched Lattigo-SEAL execution was intentionally stopped.
claims.scope: not admitted
claims.title: Cross-runtime numerical equivalence

limitations: Provider artifacts are scoped appendix evidence.
claims.reviewer_rationale: Provider artifacts are scoped appendix evidence.
claims.scope: not admitted
claims.title: General external-autotuner integration

limitations: One research host does not establish production performance.
claims.reviewer_rationale: One research host does not establish production performance.
claims.scope: not admitted
claims.title: Production latency

limitations: Runtime distributions and implementations are not universally covered.
claims.reviewer_rationale: Runtime distributions and implementations are not universally covered.
claims.scope: not admitted
claims.title: Universal 128-bit runtime security

semantics: paper_claim_allowed means that the paper may use only claims whose paper_admitted field is true
